measurement: own connections: only TCP connections whose SYN is in the trace (features/connections.py)
method: GBT headline, RF baseline; 5-fold StratifiedGroupKFold by prompt_group (shuffle, seed 42), identical folds for every model and ablation; temporal holdout trains on rounds 1–3 minus every prompt seen in rounds 4–5; macro-F1 with 95% cluster bootstrap over prompt groups (2000 resamples); model comparisons are paired group-bootstrap differences. Ports never features.

session.design: arms collected in one session, one trace at a time; balanced rounds (every condition of every arm gets n/rounds traces per round); all conditions interleaved in a seeded random order within each round; arms share the prompt of an item and alternate with the order rotated per item; one agent set per arm and topology, restarted each round; a trace with any agent error is failed and retried once; models warmed up outside capture

single_feature.note: top 5 chosen on these folds out of 35 features, so their scores are optimistic

vs_tls_control.note: a = C1, b = TLS control TLS arm; per-class difference CIs from independent group bootstraps of the two sets

first_request.definition: TCP payload bytes of the first request message that reaches an agent (the caller → orchestrator link is not captured): on the agent link, opened by the trace, whose first post-handshake request starts earliest, the request-direction writes ≤ 50 ms apart, TLS ClientHello and client Finished excluded; from headers only.
